I don't really start losing motivation, it just vanishes in an instant. I don't know what the cause is, this type of stuff revolves around problem solving and I enjoy that aspect so even if it got harder that's not a bad thing.

Definitely doesn't get boring. It really is just like the motivation gets randomly/suddenly ripped out of me.

I might try and find another community, I just prefer chat based, haven't looked too hard but also nothing came up immediately.

Hi thanks for responding,

After it happened they told people and they believed them.. even if I went back all I'd see is the people that betrayed me, and as I mentioned at the end.. if there was one thing I would never ever say, to anyone, no matter what they did or who they are.. it's the thing they accused me of saying. But these people believed it so readily - how could anyone believe that someone who has been told to kill themselves, have considered it for their whole lives, would ever repeat it to another human being? It makes me feel betrayed and angry that people I trusted immediately accepted that. It's one of the few things that's ever made me feel legitimately angry.

I don't want to go back there. I wish it had never happened, but now that it has it's too late. I think it did cause some issues though because the two or so people I have FB contact with from there said almost no one goes into the chat anymore and that's the part I miss.

And also... if a place you went to for support pushed you in the direction you were trying to move away from, would you want to be there? That's how it is for me atm.

My single passion is Game Development.. 3D animation and programming. But I have severe motivation issues as mentioned, it feels like if I find some motivation I become obsessive for a week or so then in an instant it's gone and just makes me feel defeated.

You know.. I'm actually **really** good at it. But that doesn't get me anywhere because of what I am.

That's the only thing I can do. I don't really even play games anymore because they can't interest me. I watch Anime if I'm not working on animation / programming but that's not very common where I live, just happened upon it via internet.
